title: Right / left movements (KMeans)
summary: 5-minute recording in which Andrew made right, left and up-left-down movements. Goal: tell the movement types apart.
result: 7/7 noted movements classified correctly with 4 s windows and k = 4 (proof of concept, very little data)
method: k-means on 4 s windows (k = 4), angles relative to the resting position
